inlines.v: STIGMATIC, STIGMATICAL adjective 1. Marked with a stigma, or with something reproachful to character. 2. Impressing with infamy or reproach. STIGMATIC, noun 1. A notorious profligate, or criminal who has been branded. [Little used.] 2. One who bears about him the marks of infamy or punishment. [Little used.] 3. One on whom nature has set a mark of deformity. [Little used.]
